original.question: When folded into two equal halves a rectangular sheet had a perimeter of 48cm for each part folded along one set of sides and the same is 66cm when folded along the other set of sides. Find the area of the sheet.
original.rationale:
Let the sheet be folded along its breadth and its perimeter = 48cm
Therefore, (l/2 + b) = 48 ... (i)
Now, let the sheet be folded along its length, and the perimeter = 66cm
(l + b/2)= 66 …... (ii)
Solving (i) and (ii), we get,
l = 56cm, b = 20cm
Area = l*b
Area = 1120 cm2
ANSWER IS B

L + W/2 + L + W/2 = 48
2L + W = 48  (1)

When the rectangle is folded along the width, each half has a perimeter of 66cm. The perimeter of half of the rectangle is made up of the width and half the length on each side plus the width again, so we have:

(l + b/2)= 66 …... (ii)

l = 56cm, b = 20cm
Area = l*b
Area = 1120 cm2
ANSWER IS B

Let the sheet be folded along its breadth and its perimeter = 48cm
Therefore, (l/2 + b) = 48 ... (i)
Now, let the sheet be folded along its length, and the perimeter = 66cm
(l + b/2)= 66 …... (ii)
Solving (i) and (ii), we get,
l = 56cm, b = 20cm
Area = l*b
Area = 1120 cm2
ANSWER IS B

Let the sheet be folded along its breadth and its perimeter = 48cm
Therefore, (l/2 + b) = 48 ... (i)
Now, let the sheet be folded along its length, and the perimeter = 66cm
(l + b/2)= 66 …... (ii)
Solving (i) and (ii), we get,
l = 56cm, b = 20cm
Area = l*b
Area = 1120 cm2
ANSWER IS B
